brief.company_summary: Mirantis is a 27-year-old (founded 1999) open-source cloud infrastructure company headquartered in Campbell, CA, known for Kubernetes and OpenStack-based products (Mirantis Kubernetes Engine, k0rdent AI) serving 1,500+ enterprise customers. In 2026, Mirantis was acquired by IREN (NASDAQ: IREN), a neocloud/AI infrastructure provider, in a ~$625M all-stock deal to build a full-stack, vertically integrated AI cloud combining IREN's GPU/bare-metal infrastructure with Mirantis's Kubernetes orchestration and enterprise software layer.

Positive: Emphasis on mentorship-style growth (code review, documentation, tackling unfamiliar problems) suggests supportive environment for junior engineers
Positive: Recently earned CNCF Kubernetes AI Conformance certification, indicating technical credibility and forward momentum in AI infra space
Neutral/Uncertain: Company recently underwent acquisition by IREN (closed Aug 2026), which can bring both growth opportunity and integration/restructuring uncertainty
talking_points: Highlight any Go experience or willingness to quickly ramp up in Go, since the team explicitly welcomes candidates from other backend languages (Java, C++, Rust, C#, Python)
Emphasize CS fundamentals (concurrency, networking, data structures) and any coursework or projects involving distributed systems or databases
Mention interest in AI/ML infrastructure or GPU computing, directly relevant given Mirantis's pivot to AI infrastructure (k0rdent AI) post-IREN acquisition
Reference any open-source contributions (even small ones) as this aligns strongly with Mirantis's open-source-driven culture

Show awareness of the IREN acquisition and Mirantis's strategic shift toward being the 'software layer' of a vertically integrated AI cloud — demonstrates you've done homework on where the company is headed
